payload.name: Preserve distinct plans when updating memories
payload.description: Use when a new message describes a different plan, event, or state than an existing memory and the agent is about to UPDATE or MERGE.
content: If a candidate from a new message concerns a plan, event, or state distinct from the target existing memory, do not UPDATE or replace that memory; create a new memory with an ADD operation.
Use UPDATE or MERGE only when the new information refines or supersedes the same underlying plan, event, or state, and preserve any earlier details that remain true.

solves: A later message describing a different plan/event/state can cause an UPDATE to overwrite an existing memory and lose earlier facts. Require ADD for distinct referents; use UPDATE/MERGE only when refining the same underlying plan/event/state. Applies where a candidate targets an existing memory but the message topic differs; not where the new message revises the same plan/entity.
